description: Copies a file in Google Drive and names the copy in the same call. The copy carries the original's tabs, formatting and formulas, so a copied template matches its source. With convert set to true, an Excel, Word or PowerPoint file is copied as a Google Sheet, Doc or Slides file, which the sheets_, docs_ and slides_ tools open; the original is left as it was. With target_mime_type, the copy is converted to the Google type named, which is how a PDF or an image becomes a Google Doc with its text recognised (ocr_language sets the language for that recognition); when convert and target_mime_type are both given, target_mime_type decides the type. Returns the copy's id, name, MIME type, folders and link. Folders are not copyable: Drive refuses them with a 403 "This file cannot be copied by the user", a limit of the API rather than of permissions.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

convert.description: When true, the copy of an Excel, Word or PowerPoint file is a Google Sheet, Doc or Slides file (.xlsx and .xls to Sheets, .docx and .doc to Docs, .pptx and .ppt to Slides). A file of any other type is refused and nothing is copied. Defaults to false, a copy of the same type. Ignored when target_mime_type is given.

file_id.description: The Google Drive file ID to copy

ocr_language.description: Language hint for the text recognition when a PDF or image is converted to a Google Doc, as a BCP-47 code such as en, de or ja. Optional; Drive detects the language when it is absent.

parent_id.description: Folder ID to place the copy in (optional, defaults to the original's folder)

target_mime_type.description: The Google type the copy is converted to, e.g. application/vnd.google-apps.document for a Google Doc (a PDF or image copied this way has its text recognised), application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet or application/vnd.google-apps.presentation. Sent to Drive as the copy's mimeType, with no lookup of the source's type; Drive refuses a conversion it does not support. Optional; takes precedence over convert.

name: gws-mcp__drive_copy_file
